component: Calendar acceptance widget status and reset contract

quotes.text: // Set status attribute of custom element as NEEDS-ACTION, after resetting.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The status callback returns for empty status or NEEDS-ACTION and does not uncheck a previous response. reset clears the checked input before removing the attribute. The standalone test calls reset before the NEEDS-ACTION case, while CSS only hides the decorative toggle. Consumers that need an unanswered state must preserve that reset step; a status string or hidden decoration alone does not prove the native radio state was cleared. This is static code/test coverage, not a live accessibility result.
title: NEEDS-ACTION relies on reset to clear the RSVP radio selection
